identities: source_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, entity TEXT NOT NULL
contracts: contract TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_key TEXT NOT NULL, amount TEXT NOT NULL, signed_on TEXT NOT NULL
resolutions: resolution_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, valid_from TEXT NOT NULL, valid_to TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (resolution_id, version), UNIQUE (digest)
resolution_entities: resolution_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, entity TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (resolution_id, version, entity)
resolution_mappings: resolution_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, system TEXT NOT NULL, source_key TEXT NOT NULL, entity TEXT NOT NULL, valid_from TEXT NOT NULL, valid_to TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (resolution_id, version, system, source_key, valid_from)
dim_entity: surrogate INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, entity TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
generations: generation INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, decision_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, base_fact_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL
generation_decisions: generation INTEGER NOT NULL, resolution_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (generation, resolution_id)
fact_rw: generation INTEGER NOT NULL, contract TEXT NOT NULL, source_key TEXT NOT NULL, signed_on TEXT NOT NULL, month TEXT NOT NULL, surrogate INTEGER NOT NULL, amount TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (generation, contract)
mart_rw: generation INTEGER NOT NULL, month TEXT NOT NULL, surrogate INTEGER NOT NULL, amount_sum TEXT NOT NULL, active_contracts INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (generation, month, surrogate)
partition_builds: generation INTEGER NOT NULL, month TEXT NOT NULL, input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, mapping_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (generation, month)
published_pointer: slot INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (slot = 1), generation INTEGER NOT NULL
